how_to_steps: Create API access/billing in Higgsfield Console

git clone https://github.com/cth9191/higgsfield-api-skill into your Claude Code or Codex skills directory (or $CODEX_HOME/skills/higgsfield-api); if already installed, update the checkout instead of re-cloning
Start a new session; the skill walks through API hookup
Prompt e.g. 'Use $higgsfield-api to generate a 5-second 720p Seedance clip: a cinematic tracking shot along a sunlit coastal road'
Or 'Use $higgsfield-api to recommend a model for animating ...; compare estimated costs before generating anything'
Or 'Use $higgsfield-api to create three short clips ...; keep the total estimated cost under $10' (budget caps optional; when set, helper tracks spend and blocks over-budget requests)
